en.searchPlaceholder: Search... (e.g. euler, tree, regex, pumping, pigeonhole, deduction)
en.graphColouringDesc: Colour vertices using the fewest colours so no adjacent pair shares a colour.
en.eulerHamiltonDesc: Find Euler trails/cycles (every edge once) and Hamilton circuits (every vertex once).
en.spanningTreeDesc: Build a minimum spanning tree using Kruskal's or Prim's greedy strategy.
en.isomorphismDesc: Determine if two graphs are isomorphic by finding the vertex mapping.
en.planarityDesc: Drag vertices to untangle a graph — or prove it's non-planar!
en.circleChordDesc: Place chords inside/outside a circuit to prove non-planarity step by step.
en.treesDesc: Build BFS/DFS spanning trees, perform traversals, answer m-ary tree questions.
en.codebreakerDesc: Crack the secret code using logic and the multiplication principle.
en.countingQuizDesc: Permutations, combinations, arrangements with repetition, distributions.
en.permsCombsDesc: Bit strings, vowel/consonant arrangements, and selection problems.
en.binomialDesc: Prove identities with block walking, Pascal's triangle, and the binomial theorem.
en.genFuncDesc: Build OGFs and find coefficients using power series identities.
en.egfDesc: Exponential generating functions: eˣ, cosh, sinh for arrangements.
en.recurrenceDesc: Identify recurrence relations and solve with characteristic equations.
en.inclusionExclusionDesc: Compute unions and complements. Solve derangement problems.
en.pigeonholeDesc: Guaranteed outcomes: minimum draws, birthday problems, Ramsey theory.
en.permCyclesDesc: Cycle notation, compositions, transpositions, and even/odd parity.
en.regexDesc: Write regexes to match language descriptions over {a, b}.
en.cfgDesc: Step through derivations, build parse trees, detect ambiguity.
en.cnfDesc: Convert a CFG to Chomsky Normal Form: Λ-productions, unit, rewrite.
en.pdaDesc: Trace PDA execution with animated stack. Accept or reject words.
en.pumpingDesc: Decompose words into uvxyz and pump to prove non-context-freeness.
en.hierarchyDesc: Classify languages, test closure properties, decidability questions.
en.naturalDeductionDesc: Build formal proofs step by step using inference rules (MP, MT, DS, HS).
en.proofFlashcardsDesc: Reconstruct mathematical proofs step by step from shuffled options.
en.proofDiscreteDesc: MCQ exam prep: theorem identification, proof techniques, computation, true/false.
en.proofComputationDesc: MCQ exam prep: CFGs, PDAs, pumping lemmas, TMs, decidability, Chomsky hierarchy.

af.treesDesc: Bou BFS/DFS spanbome, voer deurkruisings uit, beantwoord m-rige boomvrae.

af.countingQuizDesc: Permutasies, kombinasies, rangskikkings met herhaling, verdelings.
af.binomialDesc: Bewys identiteite met blokstap, Pascal se driehoek, en die binomiale stelling.
af.genFuncDesc: Bou OGF's en vind koëffisiënte met magreeks-identiteite.

af.recurrenceDesc: Identifiseer rekurrensie-relasies en los op met karakteristieke vergelykings.

af.pumpingDesc: Ontbind woorde in uvxyz en pomp om nie-konteksvryheid te bewys.

zu.treesDesc: Yakha izihlahla ze-BFS/DFS, yenza ukudlula, uphendule imibuzo yezihlahla.

zu.permsCombsDesc: Izintambo zamabhithi, ukuhlela amavaweli/amakhonsonanti, nezinkinga zokukhetha.

zu.permCyclesDesc: Ukubhalwa kwesayikili, izinhlanganiso, ama-transposition, ne-parity elinganayo/engalingani.

zu.proofFlashcardsDesc: Phinda wakhe ubufakazi bezibalo isinyathelo ngesinyathelo usebenzisa izinketho ezixutshiwe.
